events.label: HSI investigation of voter-registration nonprofits and voter-roll data

slots.name: Pennsylvania organizations
slots.sentence: According to internal government documents obtained by the legal nonprofit Democracy Forward, Homeland Security Investigations, ICE’s investigative arm, spent the past year scrutinizing hundreds of nonprofits and organizations involved in voter registration, including at least 82 organizations in Pennsylvania and 41 in New Jersey.

slots.name: New Jersey organizations
slots.sentence: including at least 82 organizations in Pennsylvania and 41 in New Jersey.

slots.name: DOJ dataset records
slots.sentence: A June report says investigators had taken in 50.6 million records from a Justice Department dataset, plus another 48.4 million records obtained through what the document calls “independent sources.”

slots.name: Independent-source records
slots.sentence: plus another 48.4 million records obtained through what the document calls “independent sources.”

slots.name: Total records analyzed
slots.sentence: That’s nearly 100 million records being analyzed for potential investigative leads.

slots.name: Cases opened
slots.sentence: This year, Homeland Security Investigations said it had opened 418 voter-fraud cases, but 318 of those 418 cases had not been referred for prosecution
